legacy_cells.I: 017_2024_Biomedical Image Segmentation Using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models A Comprehensive Review and Analysis.pdf
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–22: title/abstract, §§1–6 (including the segmentation application review, implementation discussion, challenges/limitations, and conclusions); Tables 1 (p. 4) and 2 (pp. 17–18). PDF pp. 23–26: references and final publisher note. The full extracted text for all 26 pages was inspected. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The article is a review of diffusion methods for biomedical image segmentation, not a demonstrated patient-state transition model; its own limitations discussion describes primarily static image processing. Table 2’s extracted row/column alignment is garbled, so it was not used to attribute detailed study-level results. Evidence QA: 5/5 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (100%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 5 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: All26 physical PDF pages read including all109 references. All pages rendered; figures1–3 p7,12,13 and tables1–2 p4,17,18 visually inspected; no included appendix.
Pypdf extracted duplicate embedded figure-source manuscript text on pages7,12,13; visual render confirmed actual figures and physical page numbering. No results inferred from duplicate text.
Table2 heterogeneously labels Accuracy(%) without shared metric/split/denominator and includes attack methods ASMA/MSA. Values are secondary claims, not a common benchmark or own experiment.

DeepSegDDPM is an illustrative integration discussion, not demonstrated own implementation. Probability/stochastic samples do not establish calibrated uncertainty, interpretability, bias mitigation or prospective benefit.
Cited papers/code/metrics not independently retrieved. Single-model review with skeptical reread, no independent human review or replication.
notes: No readiness facet assigned to review. Source eqs1–4 are expository denoising equations; no health-world dynamics coordinate. All raw legacy cells preserved. Table2 visually legible after prior text-alignment limitation, but underlying metric semantics remain unresolved. Article CC BY license not code/data/weight terms.
